## Loading Libraries

```{r}
library("tidyverse") 
library("janitor") 
library("patchwork") 
library("broom") 
library("curl") 
library("here")
```

## Loading Augmented File

```{r}
brca <- read_csv(here("data", "brca_augment.csv"),
                     na = c("", "NA", "N/A", "?", "null"))
```

## Visualization

### Visualization 2 - Proportion Bar Plot

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5
brca |>
  filter(!is.na(receptor_profile),
         !is.na(inferred_menopausal_state),
         !is.na(hormone_therapy)) |>
  mutate(inferred_menopausal_state = factor(inferred_menopausal_state,
                                            levels = c("Pre", "Post"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = inferred_menopausal_state,
             fill = hormone_therapy)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  facet_wrap(~ receptor_profile) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(end = 0.8) +
  labs(title = "Hormone therapy use by menopausal state and receptor profile",
       subtitle = "METABRIC cohort; patients with missing data excluded",
       x = "Menopausal state",
       y = "Proportion of patients",
       fill = "Hormone therapy",
       caption = "Source: METABRIC") +
  theme_minimal()
```

Post-menopausal patients received hormone therapy more often than pre-menopausal patients in all three receptor groups. Treatment was most common in HR+/HER2- patients and least common in Triple-Negative patients, which fits with hormone therapy targeting hormone-receptor-positive tumors.
